references.text: Isaiah warns that the wicked will be cut down and cast into fire, similar to the image Jesus uses.
Micah speaks of cutting down trees, which can be seen as a parallel to Jesus' words about trees that do not bear good fruit.
John the Baptist uses a similar image of trees that do not bear good fruit and are cut down.
The parable of the fig tree that bears no fruit, which Jesus tells, has parallels to the warning in Matthew 7:19.
James warns that the tongue can set the whole life on fire, which can be seen in connection with the image of trees being cast into fire.
